name: Victor Negrescu - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 1/2025 of the European Union for the financial year 2025 entering the surplus of the financial year 2024
part_text:
The European Union ended 2024 with 1,345 million euro left over. This report agrees that this leftover money should be added to the 2025 budget. That means member states pay less into the 2025 budget by the same amount. The report also asks the European Commission to find steadier ways to fund the Union's budget in the future, so that programmes are not squeezed when unexpected costs appear.

- The 2024 surplus of 1,345 million euro goes into the 2025 budget.
- Member states' payments into the 2025 budget drop by the same amount.
- Parliament approves the change; the budget is then final and published.
